content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the STPI Chief Operating Officer (COO) for STPI Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online before the last date mentioned in the official notification. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of STPI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Software Technology Parks of India (STPI) for its Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced by STPI?
faq.answer: STPI has announced an opening for the post of Chief Operating Officer (COO) for the STPI Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Chief Operating Officer (COO) position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for the COO post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Technology/Engineering, a Master's degree in Technology/Engineering/Science, or an MBA from a recognized and accredited university.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is below 45 years as on the last date of receipt of applications, with relaxations permissible for deserving candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chief Operating Officer position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,50,000/- per month, subject to industry standards and DPR provisions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for STPI COO recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply for the position through online mode by submitting their applications along with required educational and experience certificates via the official portal.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the screening of applications by a Screening Committee followed by a personal interview before a Search-cum-Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the application form for this contractual position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job location for the selected candidate?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be posted at the STPI Centre of Entrepreneurship (CoE) located in Chennai, Tamil Nadu.
